description: Adds a hosting plan renewal (provider, the site it hosts and its renewal date) to the signed-in user's TLDix list. Alerts go out 30, 7 and 1 days before the date.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com. A URL or www. prefix is accepted and stripped.

renewal_date.description: Renewal or expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: add_hosting_renewal
title: Track a hosting renewal
